declaredSubstitution: M10a uses the CORRECTED patch (swap lognormal and mixture log-score sources). The frozen M10a was established mis-targeted in the first run: it inverted a paired-delta field while the adverse-result assertion reads meanLogScoreNatsPerEvent.
evidenceCaptureWidened: 40 failure lines per gate, up from 6 in the first run.

comparisonWithFirstRun.verdict: DISCRIMINATING POWER IS UNCHANGED. The semantic detector count stays at 6. Fixing C3 removed noise, it did not make the suite understand the science any better. This was predicted in advance as P-R7 and is confirmed.

predictionOutcomes.P-R1: CONFIRMED with one correct exception. The WADHWA_2022_EVENTS hash failure disappeared from 14 of 15 rows. It remains only in M07b, which deliberately edits the source data file, so there the hash failure is a genuine semantic detection of the mutation rather than the CRLF confound.
predictionOutcomes.P-R2: CONFIRMED. M01, M05, M06, M07a and M11 remain DETECTED and are now hash-only.
predictionOutcomes.P-R3: CONFIRMED. No mutation flipped from DETECTED to SURVIVED, so none of the five was detected solely by the CRLF accident.
predictionOutcomes.P-R4: CONFIRMED. The six semantic detections are unchanged.
predictionOutcomes.P-R5: CONFIRMED. M03b, M04 and M10b survive.
predictionOutcomes.P-R7: CONFIRMED. The semantic count did not increase. The improvement is attribution clarity, not discriminating power.

sharpenedFinding.statement: With the confound removed, five structurally different mutations now produce EXACTLY ONE failure line, and it is byte-identical across all five.

mutations.theme: CW/CCW direction semantics inverted
Sign inversion on a paired model-comparison difference
Censoring treatment: right-censored dwells admitted to the uncensored likelihood
Motor-leakage guard removed, with no leak actually injected
Prospective prediction ordering falsified

sharpenedFinding.whyThisIsSharperThanTheFirstRun: In the first run each of these failed on TWO lines, one of which was CRLF noise. A reader could have argued the noise was masking a real semantic detector underneath. It was not. With the noise gone there is exactly one line, it is a hash mismatch, and it is the same line for every one of the five.
sharpenedFinding.whatItMeans: Inverting CW/CCW semantics, inverting a paired score sign, admitting right-censored dwells to the uncensored likelihood, removing the motor-leakage guard, and falsifying the protocol freeze date so the preregistration claims to postdate its own results are ALL INDISTINGUISHABLE to this suite. It reports that the report's hash moved. It cannot report what changed or why it matters.
sharpenedFinding.mechanism: scripts/run-observed-experiments.mjs embeds sha256 of its own source and of the protocol into the report it emits. Any edit to lib/observed-experiment.js or experiments/preregistration.v1.json therefore changes runId and trips the audit-manifest binding test, irrespective of meaning.
